name: ETHGlobal Unite 2026
description: Build the next generation of Ethereum infrastructure — from L2 tooling to cross-chain protocols — at ETHGlobal's flagship 2026 event.
longDescription:
ETHGlobal Unite 2026 is the premier Ethereum hackathon of the year, bringing together the best builders, protocols, and sponsors under one roof in San Francisco.

Over 72 hours, teams of up to 5 will compete across tracks including DeFi Infrastructure, ZK Applications, Developer Tooling, and Consumer Apps. Top protocols including Uniswap, Aave, Optimism, and Chainlink will be offering bounties on top of the main prize pool.

## What to Build

We're looking for projects that push the boundary of what's possible on Ethereum and its L2 ecosystem. Whether you're building a novel DEX mechanism, a ZK identity layer, or a consumer app that onboards the next million users — this is your stage.

## Judging

Projects will be evaluated by a panel of protocol leads and veteran Ethereum builders on technical innovation, real-world impact, code quality, and presentation.

judgingCriteria.name: Technical Innovation
judgingCriteria.description: How novel and technically impressive is the implementation?

judgingCriteria.name: Real-World Impact
judgingCriteria.description: Does this solve a meaningful problem for real users?

judgingCriteria.name: Code Quality
judgingCriteria.description: Is the codebase clean, well-structured, and production-ready?

judgingCriteria.name: Presentation
judgingCriteria.description: How clearly does the team communicate their project?

judgingCriteria.name: UX & Design
judgingCriteria.description: Is the user experience intuitive and polished?

name: Lablab GPT-5 Hackathon
description: Be among the first builders to ship real products with GPT-5 — a 48-hour online sprint to turn the world's most powerful model into something that matters.
longDescription:
OpenAI just dropped GPT-5. Now it's your turn. Lablab.ai is hosting the first major hackathon built around GPT-5's capabilities — multimodal reasoning, 1M+ context windows, and real-time voice.

This is a fully online event open to builders worldwide. No team required — solo entries welcome. You'll have access to GPT-5 API credits sponsored by OpenAI for the duration of the event.

## Tracks

- **Productivity** — Tools that save knowledge workers 10+ hours a week
- **Healthcare** — Applications that augment clinical decision-making
- **Education** — Personalized learning experiences at scale
- **Open Track** — Build anything compelling with GPT-5

## Resources

Mentors from OpenAI, Google DeepMind, and Anthropic will be available via Discord throughout the event. API credits provided to all registered teams.

judgingCriteria.name: GPT-5 Utilisation
judgingCriteria.description: How creatively and effectively does the project leverage GPT-5's unique capabilities?

judgingCriteria.name: Problem-Solution Fit
judgingCriteria.description: Is this solving a real problem people actually have?

judgingCriteria.name: Demo Quality
judgingCriteria.description: Does the live demo work and impress?

judgingCriteria.name: Originality
judgingCriteria.description: Is this concept fresh and differentiated?

name: AI Agents in the Wild Challenge
description: Deploy autonomous AI agents that solve real enterprise workflows — Salesforce and Slack are offering $250,000 in prizes for the most production-ready agents.
longDescription:
Salesforce and Slack are challenging the developer community to build autonomous AI agents that integrate natively into enterprise workflows.

This isn't a toy hackathon. We want agents you'd actually deploy to a real company. Agents that can reason across tools, take multi-step actions, and recover gracefully from failures.

## Integration Tracks

- **Salesforce CRM Agent** — Automate complex sales and customer ops workflows
- **Slack Workflow Agent** — Orchestrate multi-app workflows from natural language
- **Open Enterprise Track** — Any agent that makes a company more efficient

## Judging Criteria

Judges include enterprise CTOs and product leads from Salesforce and Slack. We're scoring hard on reliability, security, and practical deployability — not just demos.

## Resources

Full access to Salesforce sandbox, Slack developer environment, and $200 in API credits per team.

judgingCriteria.name: Reliability
judgingCriteria.description: Does the agent perform consistently across diverse inputs without breaking?

judgingCriteria.name: Business Impact
judgingCriteria.description: How much time or money does this save a real enterprise?

judgingCriteria.name: Technical Depth
judgingCriteria.description: Quality of agent architecture, tool use, and error handling

judgingCriteria.name: Security
judgingCriteria.description: Does the agent handle sensitive data safely and follow least-privilege principles?

name: Solana Breakpoint Hackathon 2026
description: Build on the fastest chain in crypto — DePIN, consumer apps, DeFi, and NFT infrastructure projects eligible for $120,000 in Solana Foundation grants.
longDescription:
The Solana Foundation is back with the Breakpoint Hackathon, co-hosted on DoraHacks. This year's theme is **Real World Utility** — projects that solve problems outside of crypto.

## Tracks

- **DePIN** — Decentralized physical infrastructure: mapping, wireless, compute, energy
- **Consumer** — Apps with a real shot at 10,000+ daily active users
- **DeFi** — Novel financial primitives, liquidity innovations, or trading infrastructure
- **Infrastructure** — Developer tooling, indexers, RPC improvements, mobile SDK contributions

## Prizes & Grants

Winners receive both cash prizes and potential follow-on grants from the Solana Foundation Ecosystem Fund. Top DePIN projects will be reviewed for a fast-track into the Solana Accelerator.

## Requirements

Projects must deploy to Solana mainnet or devnet. Rust, TypeScript, and Python are all welcome. Anchor framework recommended but not required.

judgingCriteria.name: Technical Execution
judgingCriteria.description: Code quality, architecture, and correct use of Solana primitives

judgingCriteria.name: Real-World Utility
judgingCriteria.description: Does this solve a problem for non-crypto users?

judgingCriteria.name: Originality
judgingCriteria.description: Is the concept novel within the Solana ecosystem?

judgingCriteria.name: Team & Roadmap
judgingCriteria.description: Is the team credible and does the project have a believable path to mainnet?

name: Build AI NYC 2026
description: New York's biggest in-person AI hackathon — 36 hours, 400 builders, and $10,000 to the team that ships the most impressive product by Sunday noon.
longDescription:
Build AI NYC is a community-run hackathon hosted at the Newlab at Brooklyn Navy Yard — 36 hours of building, pitching, and shipping.

This is a smaller, more intimate event than the big tech-sponsored hackathons. No corporate agenda. No mandatory API integrations. Just builders, food, caffeine, and great Wi-Fi.

## Format

Friday 6pm kickoff → Sunday noon submissions → Sunday 2pm pitches → 4pm awards.

Solo builds and teams welcome. Themes are deliberately loose — build anything AI-powered that you could ship to real users within a week of the hackathon.

## Who Attends

Primarily NYC-based engineers, designers, and founders. Past attendees have gone on to raise pre-seed rounds off their hackathon projects.

## Venue

Newlab, Brooklyn Navy Yard, Building 128. Food and non-alcoholic beverages provided throughout.

judgingCriteria.name: Shippability
judgingCriteria.description: Could you put this in front of real users today?

judgingCriteria.name: Ambition
judgingCriteria.description: How big is the idea if it works?

judgingCriteria.name: Execution
judgingCriteria.description: How much did you actually build in 36 hours?

name: AI × Web3 Convergence Hackathon
description: The most ambitious hackathon of 2026 sits at the intersection of AI and crypto — onchain agents, verifiable AI, and AI-powered DeFi primitives are all fair game.
longDescription:
AI and Web3 are merging. Onchain AI agents are moving tokens. Verifiable compute is enabling trustless inference. zkML is making model outputs provable on-chain.

This hackathon exists specifically for builders working at this intersection. Organised jointly by DoraHacks and Near Foundation, with additional sponsorship from Bittensor, Giza, and Ritual.

## Tracks

- **Onchain Agents** — Autonomous AI agents that hold wallets and execute transactions
- **Verifiable AI** — zkML, TEE-based inference, or cryptographic attestation of model outputs
- **AI-Powered DeFi** — Trading strategies, risk models, or liquidity protocols that leverage AI
- **AI NFTs & Digital Assets** — Generative or interactive assets where AI is a first-class primitive

## Why This Matters

The winning projects in this hackathon could define an entirely new category of software. Judges include founders of protocols building in this exact space.

judgingCriteria.name: Technical Depth
judgingCriteria.description: How sophisticated is the AI + crypto integration? Depth over polish.

judgingCriteria.name: Novelty
judgingCriteria.description: Is this something that couldn't have been built 12 months ago?

judgingCriteria.name: Potential Impact
judgingCriteria.description: If this works at scale, how big is the surface area of change?

judgingCriteria.name: Demo & Communication
judgingCriteria.description: Can you explain this clearly to a technical judge in 3 minutes?
